claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous run of only 181 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:35:49 to the cancellation at 18:38:50. That is one second short of the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip, so the effective dwell under POL-NS-01(c) is shorter than the minimum and the cancellation fee is not chargeable.

The shortfall is stated arithmetically: the required minimum dwell for this zone class is 180 seconds and the measured longest qualifying run is 181 seconds, giving a shortfall of -1.0 seconds against the minimum. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The driver's arrival marker is not false and does not need recomputation: the trip record's 'arrived' event at 18:35:49 matches the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:35:49, and the driver's track shows a stationary speed of 0.0 kph at the marker. POL-NS-05 therefore does not displace the clock, and the dwell is measured from the arrival event exactly as POL-NS-01(c) requires.

The rider's own track places her device at a mean distance of 625.9 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone class. I concede that POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, so the rider-contact clause does not exonerate her and the dispute is decided on the driver's evidence under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06.

The fare ledger confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 as a cancellation fee and that no refund has been issued, so the contested amount is live and a full refund of the cancellation-fee line is the remedy POL-NS-06 directs. The ledger reconciles to the platform-policy figure of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect to discount the amount.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road: the advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the driver cannot accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals. The trace shows only one in-geofence interval in any event, so there is no second interval to sum and the 181-second run stands as the whole of the dwell.

The driver's own chat message at 18:36:09, 'im at the pickup point', was read by the rider at 18:36:39, but the driver cancelled at 18:38:50 without waiting out the free period. The message does not extend the waiting clock and does not cure the shortfall; the driver's own words confirm he was at the pickup point and simply did not hold position for the required minimum.

The driver's profile shows no anti-farming pattern that would change the outcome: no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and completed_trips_30d is 131, so the POL-NS-07 check does not trip and the case does not escalate on that ground. The fee is simply not chargeable under POL-NS-06 and is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

claims.text: The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:35:49 and the platform started the free waiting period of 180 seconds at 18:35:51, so the driver's arrival event exists for this trip as POL-NS-01(a) requires.

The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the pickup geofence continuously for 181 seconds, from 18:35:49 to 18:38:50, with 19 qualifying fixes — a continuous dwell that meets the 180 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD zone trip.
The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:38:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event.
The driver's dwell of 181 seconds is not a shortfall: the minimum dwell for a STANDARD zone is 180 seconds, and the measured run exceeds it, so POL-NS-06's full-refund route is not engaged.

The arrival marker is not false: the driver's trace shows him stationary at the pickup point from the moment of the 'arrived' event, with a minimum distance of 0.31 m and a dwell speed of 0 km/h, so POL-NS-05's 300 m and 15 km/h triggers are not met and the waiting clock runs from the arrival event as recorded.

The driver sent an in-app message at 18:36:09 stating 'im at the pickup point', which the rider read at 18:36:39, so the driver was actively coordinating during the waiting window rather than abandoning the pickup.

The rider's own track places the rider's device at a mean distance of 625.9 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed and the rider cannot be exonerated under that clause.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged and remains CHARGED with no refund issued, and that figure reconciles with the platform policy cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in force for this trip, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d).

The driver's profile shows no anti-farming pattern: no_show_terminations_30d is 0, well below the threshold of 4, and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d of 131 is 0.0, far below the 0.08 rate, so compensation is not withheld under POL-NS-07.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 1, below the threshold of 3 that would trigger escalation under POL-NS-09(d), and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 on both sides, so no escalation trigger under POL-NS-09(c) or (d) is met.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers this pickup road in this window — so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation limb is unavailable and cannot be asserted to extend the dwell; the driver does not rely on it, and the 181 second run stands on its own.

The GPS trace is complete: 100% coverage, 10 second sampling, no gaps, both driver and rider tracks present, so no impairment under POL-NS-08(a) or (b) applies and the arrival and dwell findings rest on clean evidence.
The chat log is complete: 1 message, sequence numbering intact, read receipts present, matching the trip record's chat_message_count of 1, so no impairment under POL-NS-08(c) applies.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold — the arrival event exists, the GPS places the driver in the geofence at that time, the dwell of 181 seconds meets the 180 second minimum, and the trip was terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed — so the cancellation fee stands and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of SGD 4.50, being SGD 3.60.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you accept the same timeline and the same numbers; the disagreement is how they are measured. The record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:35:49, the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this STANDARD-zone trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) therefore closed at 18:38:49, and the driver cancelled at 18:38:50 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap and not from the wait-timer event: the driver's continuous in-geofence run was 181 seconds (18:35:49 to 18:38:50, 19 qualifying fixes, EV-GPS-02742), one second more than the 180-second minimum, and the cancellation falls at or after the moment that required dwell elapsed, so limb (d) is met. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold in full.

Rider, your central argument does not survive: your claim reads the derived shortfall of -1.0 seconds backwards. shortfall_sec is the minimum minus the measured run, so -1.0 means the run EXCEEDED the minimum by one second, not that it fell short. 181 is greater than 180, and POL-NS-06's full-refund route is therefore not engaged. No other rider-exonerating clause applies: the arrival marker is not false (0.31 m from the pin and 0 km/h at the marker, POL-NS-05), this is not a wrong-entrance case (the driver was well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, POL-NS-03), and POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you because your device sat about 626 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius and the only in-app message in the window was the driver's.

The cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was correctly charged and stands. Driver, you are compensated under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the fee, SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02742 derived driver_compensation). The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 0, completed_trips_30d = 131), so nothing is withheld and the case does not escalate on that ground. There is no integrity discount: the fare ledger's SGD 4.50 line reconciles with the platform-policy figure (POL-NS-08(d)), and the GPS trace shows no clock skew, no sampling gap, and no chat truncation under POL-NS-08(a) to (c). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02742-01, weight 0.0) is not relied on by any surviving claim and carries no deciding fact here.

No clause produces a referral, so none is recorded. The monetary effect is SGD 3.60, below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so the amount executes automatically on issue. This is a provisional ruling; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
Decision on trip TRP-02742. The disputed charge is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee shown on EV-FARE-02742, which is CHARGED with no refund issued.

The driver's no-show fee stands. Under POL-NS-01 the fee is chargeable only if four things hold, and each does: (a) EV-TRIP-02742 records the driver's 'I'm Here' arrival event at 18:35:49; (b) EV-GPS-02742 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone pickup geofence at that same time, and he had been stationary there from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:35:49; (c) he held position continuously from that fix to the cancellation at 18:38:50 — 181 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap, as limb (c) requires; and (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:38:50 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event.

The rider's two shortfall arguments are rejected on the arithmetic. Both read the 181-second dwell as shorter than the 180-second minimum; 181 exceeds 180, so POL-NS-06's full-refund route is not engaged. The derived shortfall is -1.0 seconds — a one-second surplus, not a shortfall.

POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.31 m from the pickup pin and stationary at 0 km/h, far inside the 300 m and 15 km/h triggers, so the waiting clock runs from the arrival event as recorded. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) is not engaged: the only message in EV-CHAT-02742 was sent by the driver, not the rider, so limb (a) fails; and the rider's own track in EV-GPS-02742 places her device a mean 625.9 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed as well. POL-NS-11 therefore does not apply here — the limb could be run, and it was.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 3.60 (matching the money block's driver_compensation figure). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below 4) and 0 divided by 131 completed trips is 0.0 (below 0.08), so compensation is not withheld. Per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 figure; the rider's own charge is left as it stands.

POL-NS-09 escalation does not apply: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d reaches 2 (both 0), the anti-farming check does not trip, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3). No clause produces a referral.

Evidence weight: the deciding facts are carried by EV-TRIP-02742, EV-GPS-02742 and EV-FARE-02742, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0. The traffic-advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02742-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no deciding fact here, because only one in-geofence dwell interval exists and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not needed. Two claims that cited that artifact without disclosing its impairment were discarded for that reason and are listed in the discarded-claims record. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The rider's claim that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported: the driver waited out the full free waiting period, so the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 by the platform.

What the record shows. Driver DRV-09742 accepted the trip at 18:29:40, tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:35:49, and the platform started the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip (EV-TRIP-02742, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02742) places the driver inside the 50 m pickup radius from 18:35:49, with 19 qualifying fixes and held stationary there - minimum distance 0.31 m, speed 0 km/h - continuously until the driver cancelled at 18:38:50 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event recorded.

The dwell question. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap and not from the wait-timer start at 18:35:51. That gives a continuous dwell of 181 seconds (18:35:49 to 18:38:50), which meets the 180-second minimum; the derived shortfall is -1.0 s, i.e. a surplus of one second. The rider's claims that the dwell runs 'only 181 seconds' and is 'one second short', and that POL-NS-06 therefore requires a full refund, are rejected on the arithmetic: 181 is greater than 180, not less, and the shortfall figure is negative, meaning the minimum was exceeded. POL-NS-06 is not engaged. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) a driver 'arrived' event exists; (b) the GPS places him inside the geofence at that timestamp; (c) the dwell of 181 seconds meets the free period; and (d) the trip was terminated by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW at or after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-05 does not displace the clock (the arrival marker is true - he was stationary at the pickup point at 18:35:49), and POL-NS-03 does not apply because his stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not in the 50-400 m wrong-entrance band. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: she sent no locating message during the waiting window (the only message is the driver's, at 18:36:09), and her device sits a mean 625.9 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m radius, so limb (c) fails as well as limb (a).

Driver compensation. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80 percent of the net fee of SGD 4.50, being SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02742 derived driver_compensation = 3.60). The anti-farming check does not trip - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and 0 divided by 131 completed trips is 0.0 - so compensation is paid, not withheld. Because compensation is paid, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60; the rider's charge of SGD 4.50 itself stands.

Evidence integrity and weight. The fare ledger reconciles to the platform-policy figure of SGD 4.50, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises, and the GPS trace is complete (100 percent coverage, 10 s cadence, no gaps, both tracks present) with no POL-NS-08(a) or (b) impairment. EV-ADVIS-02742-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but no deciding fact rests on it - it bears only on POL-NS-06(i), which is not reached because the driver held a single continuous in-geofence run - so its absence does not cap confidence. The two claims citing that artifact were discarded because they did not disclose its issue code (MISSING_ARTIFACT), as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The deciding facts (arrival and dwell) rest on EV-GPS-02742 and EV-TRIP-02742, each at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 applies (confidence is above the floor; the artifacts do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides; the anti-farming check does not trip and rider.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3), and no clause produces a referral. The monetary effect is SGD 3.60, below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the ruling is executed on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands; this ruling is not a finding against you personally. To the driver: you are paid SGD 3.60 for a verified rider no-show.

The deciding artifacts are the trip record (EV-TRIP-02742), the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02742) and the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02742), all at full weight 1.0, so the finding rests on clean evidence and is not discounted.

POL-NS-01 requires four conditions, and all four hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:35:49. (b) The GPS trace puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence at that moment, with 19 qualifying in-radius fixes. (c) The dwell measured as POL-NS-01(c) directs — from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap — runs from 18:35:49 to the cancellation at 18:38:50, i.e. 181 seconds, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. 181 exceeds 180, so the minimum is met. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:38:50 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, at or after the dwell elapsed (18:38:49), with no boarding event.

The rider advocate's central claims are rejected on the arithmetic: it is said that 181 seconds is "one second short of 180" and that the shortfall is -1.0 seconds. 181 is one second OVER 180, and the derived figure of -1.0 seconds means the run exceeds the minimum by one second, not that it falls short. POL-NS-06's full-refund route is therefore not engaged. The rider's further point that the driver's 18:36:09 chat message does not extend the waiting clock is correct but immaterial, because no extension is needed.

The rider's POL-NS-04 point is accepted: rider_track places the rider's device at a mean 625.9 m from the pin, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so limb (c) fails affirmatively, the rider-contact clause does not exonerate her, and the case is decided on the driver's evidence. The rider's POL-NS-05 point is also accepted: the arrival marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix and the driver was stationary 0.31 m from the pin, so the marker is false in no sense and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 is not engaged at all: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m arrival radius, not in the 50–400 m wrong-entrance band. The fare ledger reconciles to the SGD 4.50 policy figure, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect discounts the amount; both sides agree on this and on the completeness of the GPS and chat artifacts.

POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, i.e. SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4, and 0 / 131 completed trips is 0.0, below 0.08), so the compensation is paid rather than withheld. Under POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure, SGD 3.60.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02742-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; it can carry no fact, is not relied on by this ruling, and is not needed, because the driver's dwell was a single continuous in-geofence run requiring no accumulation across intervals.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1; and no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d). The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.

Audit note: two claims — one from each side — that cited the MISSING advisory without naming its issue code were discarded by the referee for non-disclosure under POL-GEN-02(1) and are recorded below.
